mentions.name: EasyAnalytica
mentions.description: This web app provides a single place for all your dashboards, generating dashboards automatically from data without using AI. It supports importing data from Google Sheets, APIs, URLs, and recently added Google Search Console (GSC) as a data source, with plans to add more sources.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building https://EasyAnalytica.com - single place for all your dashboards. It generates dashboards automatically from data without using ai. It supports getting data from google sheets, api's, url's etc. I have recently added support for gsc as data source and i plan to continue adding more in coming weeks.
mentions.author: pdyc
